surat-textiles.title: Surat textile value chain

side.text: Zari thread feeds weaving (borders, brocade) and embroidery

surat-textiles.note: Traders coordinate across the chain: they buy grey fabric and send it to process houses and embroidery units on job-work. Warping and sizing are not a separate page: they are mostly done inside weaving units.

items.title: Polyester yarn (POY / FDY)
items.blurb: Makes POY and FDY from PTA and MEG. Mostly large companies.

items.title: Texturising and twisting (DTY)
items.note: Twisting merged here; warping and sizing are covered on the weaving page
items.blurb: Turns POY into stretch yarn (DTY) and twists yarn for weavers.

items.title: MMF weaving (water-jet, rapier, air-jet)
items.blurb: Weaves grey fabric on water-jet, rapier and air-jet looms.

items.title: Processing: dyeing and printing (job-work)
